parameter.name: serialPort
parameter.label: Serial Port
parameter.description: Serial port that the ComfoAir is connected to

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Gateway Hostname/IP
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the ComfoConnect gateway

parameter.name: pin
parameter.label: PIN Code
parameter.description: Numeric PIN for gateway authentication (optional - leave blank if not set on device)

parameter.name: clientUuid
parameter.label: Client UUID
parameter.description: Custom UUID for app registration (optional, defaults to "openHAB" + null bytes)

parameter.name: gatewayUuid
parameter.label: Gateway UUID
parameter.description: UUID of the ComfoConnect gateway (auto-populated from discovery)

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Refresh interval in seconds for device state updates

parameter.name: autoTakeover
parameter.label: Auto Takeover Session
parameter.description: Automatically take over existing session if another app is logged in

parameter.name: defaultCommandTimeout
parameter.label: Default Command Timeout
parameter.description: Timeout in seconds for sending commands to the device
